title: Chapter 194
text:
The onlookers all looked at Flying Mantis Prawn with admiration.

This was a true warrior who dared to face death head-on.

Then, they all stepped back and stood further away, afraid that they would be splashed with blood.

Han Xiao was very clear about the source of Flying Mantis Prawn's information. This was the influence of Bun-hit-dog's video. Leaking some information to arouse the curiosity of the players about his mysterious identity and increase his fame was something that he had tacitly allowed.

The leaked information was not important to Han Xiao. Players were not NPCs. They did not have a huge information network and did not have key information. Knowing his real name was useless. On the contrary, the more the video spread, the more his influence would increase.

Therefore, Han Xiao had already guessed that there would be players who would ask him directly. He just nodded calmly and did not say anything else.

Flying Mantis Prawn was stunned. This was completely different from what he had imagined. How could Black Phantom be so calm when his identity was exposed?

Did Black Phantom not care at all about strangers knowing his identity?

Or … in a place that the players did not know, Black Phantom's identity was no longer a secret? Therefore, this method was useless.

Flying Mantis Prawn was frustrated.

Black Phantom was too stable. He did not feel like he had any weaknesses.

The onlookers looked at each other and became even more curious.

What kind of person was he?

Flying Mantis Prawn did not give up. He asked again, "I want to join the Germinal Organization. Do you know how to do that?" Everyone knew that Black Phantom was the enemy of the Germinal Organization. He asked this on purpose.

Hey, young man, are you provoking me?

Han Xiao did not say anything and directly reduced his favorability by three points as a punishment.

Flying Mantis Prawn's face turned green. This reaction was too direct. There was no warning at all!

Han Xiao suddenly had a new idea. Since he had a certain amount of influence among the players, maybe he could guide them in choosing a faction.

Therefore, he paused and said, "The war is about to break out. The Germinal Organization will definitely lose. If you want to commit suicide, it's up to you. If you want to join the Dark Net, I can write a letter of recommendation. If you want to join the Germinal Organization, get lost. "

Everyone was excited. Black Phantom finally had a different reaction. He even said something that they did not know. They whispered among themselves.

"Expedition? The Six Nations and the Germinal Organization are going to war? "

"He definitely knows more than we do. His judgment is definitely reliable."

"Then, joining the Germinal Organization is a huge loss."

The players were in an uproar. Only the people from the Andrea Continent had joined the Germinal Organization. Han Xiao's words would soon be posted on the forum, and those who wanted to join the Germinal Organization would give up on that idea.

He would not let go of any opportunity to attack the Germinal Organization. He had not been stirring up trouble recently, and the Germinal Organization seemed to have been living peacefully for a while. He could not tolerate it at all.

The player noticed another important point. "He mentioned the Dark Net. That's a hidden force, right? Can he let us join the Dark Net?"

Han Xiao smiled. He opened the shop page that he hadn't seen in a long time and added a new item.

[Faction Recommendation Letter]: You can use this item to open the Blood Pact Society faction. Note: The Blood Pact Society is an assassin organization under the Dark Net.

Price: 250,000 Aquamarine Dollars

"250,000?" Everyone was dumbfounded. To them, this was a sky-high price. No one could afford it.

Originally, joining the Blood Pact Society required one to undergo a series of missions and tests. However, Han Xiao had cut them off. With his relationship with the Dark Net, it was only a matter of words for him to introduce some players to join.

A few months ago, Han Xiao had bought the Blood Pact Society certificate from Antonio for 200,000 Aquamarine Dollars. He had increased the price by 25% based on that. After all, it was inflation. He felt that it was a reasonable price increase.

With such a high price, normal players would naturally be dissuaded. Han Xiao's original intention was not to sell it on a large scale. His target customers were the professional players from the clubs. Only with the financial support of the big guilds could they afford such a price.

Professional players were the type of players who were most willing to use any means to become stronger. This plan could attract professional players and help him expand his backup team. Of course, the main reason was to make money.

"It's not enough to just have cheap skills and normal goods. I also need luxury goods with sky-high prices to enrich my product structure," Han Xiaoxin said.

250,000 Aquamarine Dollars was a sum that most guilds could not afford. However, they were rich and could buy other players' Aquamarine Dollars through real life currency.

"Let's see how many guilds can wake up to the benefits of joining a new hidden faction."

He was now Taigong Han's bait. Those who were willing to take the bait.

…

"Unbelievable, the most expensive item so far!" "Black Phantom: Germinal Organization Will Lose" …

Posts with such titles appeared on the Blue Star forum and immediately attracted the attention of the players. Seeing the sky-high price of 250,000 Aquamarine Dollars, they were all stunned.

"Wow, is this faction gold-plated like (((.)))?"

"Blood Pact Society, I wonder what it does."

"The price is ridiculously high. What's so special about this faction called Blood Pact Society?"

"Have you heard of this faction before?" This person was just asking casually and did not expect someone to really reply. "I triggered the Blood Pact Society's joining mission. It's very complicated and difficult. It's introduced as an assassin organization. Currently, I don't know what benefits it has, but to me, spending 250,000 just to skip the prerequisite mission is not worth it."

The sky-high price of 250,000 Aquamarine Dollars caused a lot of discussion. The average wealth of players now was around 3,000 to 5,000 Aquamarine Dollars. It was not too difficult for guilds to gather 250,000 Aquamarine Dollars. After all, the number of players was constantly increasing.

However, most guilds felt that it was not worth it. 250,000 Aquamarine Dollars for a Aquamarine Dollar letter was too extravagant. The situation was not clear yet, so they decided to wait and see.

Han Xiao had influence among the normal players, but the guilds had always been rational and considered everything from the perspective of profit. Other players were playing games, but they were doing business.

Compared to the sky-high price of the Aquamarine Dollar letter, the players paid more attention to Han Xiao's news that the Six Nations and the Germinal Organization were about to start a war.

After playing for a few days, the Blue Star players all knew that the conflict between the Six Nations and the Germinal Organization was the main storyline. However, the war had started without warning, and it was an expedition, which meant that the battlefield would be in the Andrea Continent. Many players had not even chosen a faction, and their strength was not enough to participate in the main storyline mission.

In the original storyline, the war was supposed to start a few months later, and there would be local battles in every continent. Players from all over the world could participate. However, after Han Xiao's intervention, the war was not only brought forward, but it was also an expedition from the start. He felt that the impact that the players could cause was minimized.

Most importantly, most players had not triggered the main storyline mission between the Six Nations and the Germinal Organization yet.

Black Phantom said that the Germinal Organization would definitely lose, which made many people stop. Players liked excitement, and there were many who leaned toward the evil faction. There were also many who wanted to join the Germinal Organization.

However, this time, Han Xiao's influence played a role. These players started to waver. If they chose the Germinal Organization, they would have to bear the risk of being destroyed. If that was the case, they would rather choose the lawful faction of the Six Nations. Only the embrace of the strong would be warm.

One sentence made the Germinal Organization lose many potential supporters.

Han Xiao's influence on the players grew as he built his own image, and his position in the hearts of the players was strengthened.

His words would be treated as key information in the game by the players.
